items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 17:1
items.html: It is the "participation of the quality of mercy in judgment" made in the second restriction. And this matter is not noticeable in Atik and AA, which receive from the aspect corresponding to them, from the Galgalta and AB of AK, but only from the Chazeh and below of Aba and Ima, which are drawn from SAG of AK. As above in answer 269. (Item 18).
